Channel<T> creation (bounded and unbounded). Backpressure strategies and capacity management. IAsyncEnumerable integration with channel readers. Graceful shutdown and drain patterns. Hosted service lifecycle and BackgroundService registration -- see [skill:dotnet-background-services]. Async/await fundamentals and cancellation token propagation -- see [skill:dotnet-csharp-async-patterns]. Cross-references: [skill:dotnet-background-services], [skill:dotnet-csharp-async-patterns].
